dedupe_keys.name: osm driving road network quality indicators for turkiye 81 provinces code and csv outputs

description: The dataset authors publish OpenStreetMap road-quality indicators for all eighty-one provinces of Türkiye. The free Zenodo ZIP uses CC BY 4.0 and contains CSV indicators and composite scores derived from OSM PBF data and GADM boundaries. Measures cover road, segment and intersection density, largest connected component, dead ends and attribute completeness, with equal-weighted and topology-focused variants. These tables can inform uncertainty screening when preparing road-network simulations. Related catalogue data-openstreetmap supplies upstream network information, but does not explicitly cover these derived scores. Coverage is provincial summaries, not independently surveyed road completeness. High density or connectivity does not prove positional accuracy, and extraction dates are not established in the summary. Upstream licence conditions remain applicable. No archive was downloaded or quality ranking verified.
